# ionhour_project (Data Source)

Look up an Ionhour project by `id` or exact `name` (exactly one). A name shared by several projects is an error; use the id then.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a project up by exact name ...
data "ionhour_project" "payments" {
  name = "Payments"
}

# ... or by id.
data "ionhour_project" "by_id" {
  id = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric project id. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact project name. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `description` (String) Project description.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339, UTC).
